text:
alex: Quick check-in on the "progress pulse" experiment for large streaming responses. Idea: emit tiny periodic metadata frames so the edge can checkpoint progress and attempt resume-based retries instead of full replays.
sam: Short version: pulse = (seq, resume_token, visible_offset). Gateway stores last-seen seq+token, upstream accepts resume(token, seq) and returns only new tokens.
nina: How do we avoid the client seeing duplicated tokens if resume fails half-way?
tao: Also worried about gateway state bloat under 50k concurrent streams.
alex: Answers: 1) Make tokens opaque HMAC blobs with expiry and stream-id; gateway verifies but doesn't need to store raw payload beyond last token and seq. 2) Evict after idle timeout (configurable), keep only O(1) per stream. 3) On resume mismatch, fall back to hedged requests (start a parallel fresh request while the old one drains) and use circuit-breaking to avoid storms.
sam: Transport nuance: for gRPC we need an out-of-band frame type or prefix byte. For HTTP chunked we can piggyback headers in the chunk preface. We'll spec both.
nina: Billing impact? If resumes trigger generation of delta tokens, is that re-billed? Concern if multiple partial resumes happen.
tao: We should define that pulses are bill-free metadata. Only generated tokens count. Also add a throttle: max_resume_attempts per stream to stop misbehaving clients.
alex: Example pulse snippet (HTTP chunk metadata):
```
: pulse-seq=123
: resume-token=eyJhbGci...
: visible-tokens=1024
```
infra-bot: deploy: pulse-proto feature flag enabled on staging (gateway-canary-2024-09-27) :rocket:
sam: Operational metrics to add: pulse_emitted, resume_attempt, resume_ok, resume_reject, resume_expired, duplicate_delivery_detected. Also histogram for time-between-pulses.
nina: We need perf sims: worst-case client RTT 600ms, model chunk 750ms, 10k concurrent streams. Tune pulse interval and idle evict. I'll own sims and update the RFC.
tao: Security: tokens must include expiry and nonce to avoid replay. Also sign with runtime key; gateway verifies signature before attempting resume.
alex: Edge routing behaviour: if resume accepted, merge returned tail into client stream. If resume rejected, either hedged fresh run or surface fail depending on policy. We'll add per-route policy: prefer_hedge | prefer_full_restart | fast_fail.
sam: Backwards compatibility: opt-in header `X-Pulse-Enable: 1`. No-change for older clients. Gateway only emits pulses when upstream runtime advertises resume capability.
nina: Caveat: some model variants cannot support exact resume (stateless decoders). For those we fall back to conservative hedging. Mark models in catalog.
alto: (typo) -> tao: +1 to that.
alex: Next steps: add protocol appendix to RFC, perf sims, and a small prototype in staging for the dedicated runtime. I'll wire up the metrics dashboard after sims. Thanks. :thumbsup:
sam: lgtm
tao: +1
nina: +1
